methods.name: non-copying transduction
methods.description: A transduction without the copying operation, used to obtain the class of all paths from any class with unbounded shrubdepth.

methods.name: Gyárfás decomposition
methods.description: A tree-structured decomposition of a graph into bags partitioning V(G) with specific ancestor, connectivity, and hook vertex properties.

methods.name: simple interpretation
methods.description: An interpretation I of (colored) graphs in (colored) graphs defined naturally by a formula in the signature of (colored) graphs.

methods.name: simple equivalence
methods.description: A pair of first-order formulas defining inverse bijections between two classes of (colored) graphs.
